featured_reviews.name: Darshan Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a really horrible experience with Epic Infocus. Honestly, I would strongly recommend everyone to think twice before booking them.
Before taking payment, their team behaves very politely and professionally. But once you pay, everything completely changes. No proper response, no accountability, and zero professionalism.
I tried calling multiple times and even followed up on WhatsApp, but there was no response at all. It felt like once they got the money, the client doesn’t matter anymore.
What’s even worse is the way they handle customers after that. When I tried to visit the studio to get an update, I wasn’t even properly entertained. This is extremely disrespectful and unacceptable behavior.
Special mention to Nikhil Patel – if you are running this place, you seriously need to fix your team and your customer handling. This kind of attitude is not going to work in the long run.
Please don’t get trapped by their social media reels and low pricing. The reality is completely different. Save your money, time, and mental peace.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear darshan,

Can you do connect on 9637716975 as we are unable to find the booking by you. or mention your client id to get information on your booking

featured_reviews.review_text: Don’t try this studio. I am writing this after 2 months of my photoshoot. Very poor edit team, they don’t respond for weeks and suddenly say after 40 days that the selected photo can’t be edited as per reference image. They are so adamant that they don’t even allow to change the photo selected, even though they failed to edit it. One of worst studio, just showbazi nothing else. They make you fool saying everything they do via their app, but really they don’t care after shoot is completed. I will never ever recommend anyone to utilise their services.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Abhinav,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We truly apologise for the inconvenience caused and understand how frustrating delays or editing concerns can be. At Epic Infocus, we always aim to provide timely communication, high-quality edits, and complete transparency through our app and support channels, and we are reviewing your case to understand where the process fell short.

We appreciate your patience and assure you that we are taking steps to improve our editing workflow, response time, and approval system so every client receives a smooth, professional, and satisfying experience.

As a gesture of goodwill, and to ensure your next experience with us is nothing short of exceptional, we’d like to offer you the promocode WELCOME50%, which gives you a special discount on a future booking with us.

We would also request you to kindly share your Client ID so we can verify your project, check the editing history, and resolve the matter with complete accuracy. Your feedback helps us strengthen our service and maintain the quality our clients expect from us.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention. We hope to have the opportunity to serve you better and rebuild your trust in our services.

Regards,
Epic Infocus

featured_reviews.name: Adv. Ishika Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had my toddler first birthday shoot today. And it was such a good experience as my kid enjoys clicking pictures. Everything was good until the entire payment was made and raw data received.
Th team is not efficient enough to edit the pictures on time. They mention to provide edited pics 30 days after selection. But i wanted it earlier because my kids birthday was soon coming.
But for that they ask for seperate 2000 rs. While is worthless.
Since you do not get the edited pics when u want specially for the occasion it is been clicked, I don't find it worth to spend so much money here.
Pls be aware of the timings when u want the edited pics
Bcz they take lot of time

Disappointed to the core .

Not recommendable.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for sharing your feedback.
We’d like to clarify that our delivery timelines are clearly outlined in the Terms & Conditions, which were reviewed and accepted by you on May 11th, 2025 10:54 PM before making the advance payment. As mentioned, the standard editing timeline is up to 30 days due to our ongoing huge number of shoot commitments and project schedules.

To accommodate clients who need their edited pictures sooner—especially for special occasions—we offer an optional express delivery service at an additional charge of Rs.2000/- which is also mentioned in our Application through which you have done the booking & you can opt the optional service. This is entirely voluntary and designed to meet urgent requests without compromising the quality of work for others in queue.

We always strive for transparency and professionalism in our process & we expected understanding from you as a client to abide by our working procedures for smooth and efficient service delivery. Your feedback is valuable, and we will continue working to serve our clients better.
Warm Regards, 
EPIC INFOCUS.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Tapase
featured_reviews.review_text:
An Unforgettable Experience at Monalisa Lawns!

We recently celebrated my brothers Wedding at the Monalisa Lawns, and I cannot recommend this venue highly enough! From the moment we first visited, we were impressed by the beautifully maintained space, the lush greenery, and the overall peaceful yet grand ambiance.

The team at Monalisa was incredibly professional, attentive, and supportive throughout the planning process. They were always available to address our questions, offered great suggestions, and ensured every detail was perfect on the big day. Special shoutout to the event coordinator who went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly!

The lawn itself is spacious, ideal for both large gatherings and intimate ceremonies. The lighting setup in the evening made the entire space glow with a magical charm, and our photos turned out stunning thanks to the beautiful natural backdrop.

Parking was ample and convenient, and our guests kept complimenting us on the choice of venue. Whether it’s décor flexibility, vendor coordination, or just the vibe — Monalisa Lawns exceeded all expectations.

If you’re looking for an elegant, open-air venue that feels both grand and personal, Monalisa Lawns is the one. Thank you for making our special day absolutely perfect!

featured_reviews.name: Jatin Naidu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pankaj is the man for you to capture and treasure your beautiful moments of time. We had the cherishable company of Pankaj and his team at our wedding and they are incredible very professional yet very personal and emotive. They captured all the moments with complete poise and style keeping us at very ease and comfort.

The photos tell the story of our love and compassion and bring back to us every emotion and feeling from our wedding day and we look at them with joy, laughter and tears. Pankaj is truly talented and amazing. We will treasure these memories for forever. Thank you so much!!!

featured_reviews.name: Sylvester Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am deeply disappointed with the services provided by Pankaj Rokade. I booked him to cover my relatives' 25th Anniversary on December 29, 2023, and the experience was nothing short of frustrating.

From the beginning, I had to constantly follow up with him for about 4-5 months as he rarely responded to my messages or answered my calls. This lack of communication was extremely stressful and unprofessional.

Despite the persistent follow-ups, I finally received the photos and videos in May, several months after the event. The quality of the video was subpar and seemed rushed, likely because I had to continually remind him. When I requested changes to the video, he assured me he would make them, but now, nearly seven months since the event, and he has once again started ignoring my calls and messages. I still have not received the final content.

It feels like he might deliver the 25th anniversary videos by the time my relatives' 26th anniversary rolls around. This level of service is unacceptable, and I have never encountered such unprofessional behavior from a service provider.

I strongly advise against booking Pankaj Rokade for any event, as you will likely face significant hassles and potential financial loss. I would not recommend his services to anyone.
